rule: Monster hit: hit sound first (variant 1 or 2 at random, skipped if that variant still plays), then a hard-hit check (damage/64 >= monster level + offset, or one of four always-hard types). Ordinary hit stops there. Hard hit: type reaction, roll position back to previous tile, got-hit animation. Knockback (affix, arrow, or table flag): one tile away if free. Hero hit: grunt and health redraw always; flinch only when damage/64 reaches hero level (barbarian higher); flinch animation with 0-3 recovery frames skipped; knockback moves hero one tile in the monster's facing if walkable.
keep: Hit sound first and always, with a skip-if-still-playing rule per variant
Stagger and cancel only on hard hits, not on every hit
Hero flinch threshold tied to hero level
Knockback as a one-tile move, only from a flagged source
Per-family reaction data (frames, rate, variant count) reused across many characters
change: No server-side randomness for the cosmetic sound variant pick
Knockback and stagger become server-verified position events, presented by the client
Add a visible attacker-side cue for up to three attackers (donor has none)
Our own recoil frames, sounds, names and numbers
look_test: One duel scene: a dummy and three attackers from left, right and front, behind a flag feel_hit_profile with values A (sound and recoil only), B (A plus stagger on hard hits), C (B plus one-tile knockback). Dom taps each profile three times with three attackers on and says which profile shows the attacker and the big hit within one second. No release rows.
